faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions
faq.q1: How do I place an order?
faq.a1: Simply browse our products, add items to your cart, and proceed to checkout. Follow the prompts to complete your order.
faq.q2: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a2: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and other secure payment methods.
faq.a3: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping options are available at checkout.
faq.a4: We offer a 30-day return policy for most items. Items must be in original condition with tags attached.
